title: All-Hands July 2026 - Talking Points & Q&A (draft)
content:
Purpose: rough talking points and candidate Q&A for July all-hands (first pass). Goal is ~20-25m exec updates + 10m product highlight + 10m AMA prep. Keep language conversational.

Agenda (target 45-50m):
- 0:00-02:00 — Welcome + company health (me)
- 02:00-08:00 — Business & GTM highlights (Katherine)
- 08:00-18:00 — Product + Tech updates (Lucas & Asha)
- 18:00-28:00 — Operations: Dedicated & Private rollout status (Priya)
- 28:00-38:00 — People updates + hiring (Ravi)
- 38:00-48:00 — AMA (panel)
- 48:00-50:00 — Close / next steps

Top-line message (1-liner for open):
- We’re in execution mode: growth in hosted API usage, steady expansion of Dedicated contracts, and Private pilots gaining momentum — focus for next quarter is scaling predictable capacity and reducing per-token cost for customers.

Company health bullets (to say quickly):
- Revenue / usage: Hosted API volume up ~32% QoQ (driven by start-up accounts and a couple of mid-market flips).
- Dedicated: 3 new contracts signed in June (ANCA health, FinData, and BrightCMS) - expected onboarding in Q3.
- Private: 2 pilots moved to live evaluation (telecom & gov-regulated customer) - initial feedback positive on observability and KMS integration.
- Burn / runway: on plan for Series C growth targets; finance will drop a one-pager post-all-hands.

Product / Tech highlights (talking points for Lucas/Asha):
- Serving runtime improvements: 12-15% median token latency reduction for 8k seqs after kernel tuning - call out "compilation and kernel selection" work.
- Optimize features: Intelligent batching suggestions shipped as beta to 50 customers; early customers seeing 10-20% cost improvement.
- Rollouts: Canary rollout framework now supports automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants - fewer incidents during peak.
- Roadmap blurb: next quarter focus = robust autoscaling for Dedicated + faster cold-starts for Private deployments.

Operations / Dedicated & Private update (Priya):
- Capacity: Dedicated pool utilization trending 72% at peak; adding 2 more clusters in West region in July.
- Private: packaging improvements reduced on-prem install time from 4 days -> <24 hrs in internal tests (still variance depending on customer's infra).
- Compliance: SOC2 re-cert prep underway; security is coordinating evidence collection - expect updates in monthly security summary.

People / hiring + org notes (Ravi):
- Headcount: hiring priority = infra SRE (3), backend infra (2), solutions engineers (4), security engineer (1).
- New hires spotlight: onboarding notes for new PM (Hannah Li) and sales lead (Omar Castillo) - quick welcome slide.
- Culture: reminder about 'office hours' with leadership next Tues - encourage teams to bring concrete product/ops questions.

Suggested script for open (me):
- Quick welcome, gratitude for Q2 execution, nod to top customers + new logos, then hand to Katherine for GTM metrics. Keep <2 mins.

AMA - anticipated Qs + suggested answers (rough):
1) Q: "How are we addressing token cost for large-context use cases?"
   A: Short: batching, KV/prefix caching, and model/quantization recommendations via Redwood Optimize are the primary levers - engineering is tuning defaults and we’ll publish guidance + sample configs in the docs hub next week.
2) Q: "Status on Dedicated uptime SLA --- what are realistic targets?"
   A: We’re targeting 99.9% at the pool level for Standard plans; Dedicated customers can opt into higher SLAs with reserved capacity and proactive monitoring (explain tradeoffs).
3) Q: "When will Private support newer GPU types/regions?"
   A: Roadmap items listed - working on arm64 and extra region packaging; pilots expected in Q3. If a customer needs something sooner, escalate to solutions-eng and we’ll evaluate.
4) Q: "Any changes to pricing or tiering?"
   A: Not in this all-hands; any pricing changes will be announced with 30+ days notice and accompanied by migration guides.

Notes to self / presenter cues:
- Use concrete examples: mention ANCA and FinData as Dedicated wins (ask legal if we can call them by name; if not, say "enterprise healthcare and mid-market SaaS").
- Slide timing: keep product update short and visual; include a 1-slide demo GIF of smart batching in the console (ask Lucas for gif by 6/30).
- Ask leadership to call out a small anecdote about a customer who mitigated latency incidents using fallbacks.

Open items / TODOs before final deck: (priority order)
- [ ] Confirm permission to name new Dedicated logos (legal) - Priya (due 2026-06-30).
- [ ] Lucas to provide 1-slide perf graph + gif for batching (due 2026-06-30).
- [ ] Ravi to update hiring slide with recruiter pipeline numbers (due 2026-06-29).
- [ ] People Ops to draft one-liner on career ladder changes (if any) - me (Samira) to coordinate with Joanna.
- [ ] Final rehearsal: Tue 7/5 10:00 PT (confirm availability).

Presentation style notes:
- Keep language plain, avoid technical jargon in exec updates; product section can be slightly more technical but keep it approachable.
- Use "we"/"our" construction to emphasize team work.
- Call out customer impact whenever possible (latency -> user experience / cost -> ARR impact).

Unresolved questions / internal debates (capture for panel):
- How public should we be about per-customer cost savings (numbers) vs conservative examples? (ops vs. marketing debate).
- Internal ask: do we want to announce new builder templates in this all-hands or save for product launch? (risk of premature exposure).

Slack/Follow-up:
- I'll post this draft in #all-hands-thread-7-2026 for quick feedback; please add comments inline on the deck in Confluence.

---
Meta notes (for archive): this is intentionally rough - expect multiple iterations. Keep the Q&A list to top 6 questions max; pull other questions into a "post-all-hands FAQ" doc.

(Notes-to-self: remember to mention the Improve/Optimize chart that shows token-cost delta for a representative customer - ask analytics for a vetted data point.)
